about: Modwerk source-only ram-machines packages for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/ram-machines.

mods.title: RAM Record and Playback
mods.summary: RAM-R1 records a temporary mono take from the master mix or inputs when triggered. RAM-P1 plays that shared take using the native sample controls.
mods.description: RAM-R1 records a temporary mono take from the master mix or inputs when triggered. RAM-P1 plays that shared take using the native sample controls.
mods.author: sumedho
mods.on_unit: The author reports this build fully tested and working with all six mods on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 and 1.54, for about one to two hours including project save/reload and a power cycle (2026-10-14).
